I'm Deepak Saini.

Principal Statistical Programmer

About Me

Principal-level statistical programming lead with over 10 years of expertise in PK/PD analytics, Base/Advanced SAS, R and R-Shiny application development. Proven track record designing interactive dashboards for real-time decision support, leading global teams, and delivering regulatory-compliant ADaM/SDTM datasets for oncology and beyond. Skilled in workflow automation, talent mentorship, and strategic data visualization to accelerate regulatory submissions and clinical insights.

Experience

IQVIA, UK

Associate Principal Statistical Programmer, May 2024 - Present

  • Served as an EPTM study lead, coordinating cross-functional programming efforts, managing timelines and deliverables, and driving adherence to ICH GCP and internal SOPs.
  • Programmed key ADaM datasets like ADLB, ADQS, ADHOLTER, ADEG, ADVS, ADUC etc. Authored comprehensive ADaM specifications & SAS programming for ADPC & ADPP datasets, ensuring full alignment with CDISC ADaM IG v1.1+ and seamless handoff to downstream PK/PD analyses.
  • Led NCA and population PK analyses (ADPC, ADPP, POPPK, POPPKPD), generating 150+ TLFs for regulatory submissions under tight timelines.
  • Developed and validated Non-Compartmental Analysis (NCA) TLFs including tables, listings, and figures to deliver critical PK insights for clinical and regulatory teams.
  • Conducted detailed SDTM reviews for PC and PP domains, as well as key safety domains (AE, LB, CM etc.), identifying mapping discrepancies and ensuring 100% compliance with latest SDTM IG.
  • Spearheaded a SAS macro development initiative, designing reusable, parameter-driven macros that automated repetitive tasks, improved coding consistency, and accelerated ADaM datasets and TLF production.
  • Crafted a production-ready R Shiny dashboard for PK/PD reporting on CDISC-compliant datasets, enabling real-time visualization of time-series concentration plots, median profiles, and descriptive statistics.
  • Extensively worked on Pinnacle 21 validation and ADaM CRT package.

GSK, Bengaluru, India

Lead Statistical Programmer, Dec 2018 - May 2024

  • Served as Study Lead for a portfolio of Phase I–III oncology trials—including solid tumor and hematologic (non‐solid) indications—overseeing end-to-end statistical programming deliverables (protocol review, SDTM review, ADaM programming, TLF generation) and coordinating cross-functional teams to ensure on-time, CDISC- and ICH-GCP-compliant submissions.
  • Generated key CDISC safety, PK and efficacy ADaM datasets for such as ADSL, ADRS, ADTR, ADTTE, ADDATES, ADAE, ADLB, ADEX, ADBIOMRK, ADPC, ADPP etc.
  • Worked on ADaM Oncology Efficacy endpoints - PFS, DOR, TTR, OS, DCR & BOR.
  • Applied various statistical methods, including Odds Ratio (OR), Relative Risk (RR), Absolute Risk Difference (ARD), Hazard ratio, Fisher Exact, Z-test, KM Quartiles etc.
  • Worked on various SAS graphical procedures like PROC SGPLOT, PROC SGPANEL and SAS GTL and generated various Box Plots, Line Plots, Scatter Plots, KM Survival Plots, and waterfall Plots.
  • Utilized SAS procedures such as PROC LOGISTIC, PROC LIFETEST, PROC MEANS, and PROC FREQ etc.
  • Worked on PK/PD reporting and generated key NCA TLFs. Created various PK Time Series Plots, PK Summary tables & Listings.
  • Created an R Shiny dashboard for the ADaM EX dataset using R-shiny package.
  • Created SAS-based tool to automate SDTM edit checks and output issue log in XLS.
  • As part of the Oncology Focus Group, I was involved in developing standard SAS macros and developed standard ADaM specifications as well.
  • Involved in mentoring New Joiners (Freshers and mid-experienced Programmers).
  • Worked on multiple CDISC study submissions like ISS, DSUR, DRB etc.
  • Worked on ADaM CRT package creation and Pinnacle validation.

TCS, Delhi, India

SDTM Mapping Programmer, Dec 2017 - Dec 2018

  • Worked as a Process Lead for Pfizer and was involved in leading SDTM deliverables.
  • Worked on Phase I - III Clinical trials involving PK & Safety as Primary endpoints.
  • Worked in various Therapeutic Areas like Oncology and Arthritis.
  • Developed and Validated CDISC SDTM domains such as Exposure (EX), Adverse Events (AE), Lab (LB), Vital Signs (VS), Oncology SDTMs (TU, TR and RS) etc.
  • Developed and validated CDISC SDTM domains for PK concentration (PC) and parameters (PP), mapping raw SMS2000 files into SDTM datasets.
  • Developed SDTM define and CRT package.
  • Merged raw PC data with SMS2000 TXT files received from the CPMS team.
  • Involved in developing various study specific SAS macros.

Accenture, Bengaluru, India

SDTM Mapping Programmer, Aug 2015 - Dec 2017

  • Worked as a SDTM Programmer in various TAs like Oncology, Vaccines etc.
  • Mapped various CDISC SDTMs such as Oncology (TU, TR & RS), Safety (AE, LB, EG),PK (PC & PP) by following CDISC SDTM IG.
  • Partnered with QC teams to validate SDTM domains using SAS programming.
  • Worked on blockbuster drug - Keytruda (Pembrolizumab).
  • Involved in SDTM Mapping Spec creation, aCRF Annotation, Pinnacle validation, programming and validation through PL/SQL programming. Worked on complex PL/SQL queries on the SQL Developer tool.
  • Worked on SDTM define, pinnacle 21 and CRT package.
